%dw 2.0 output text/plain fun sanitize(val: Any) = if (val == null) "" else (val as String replace "|" with "-" replace "\n" with " " replace "\r" with "")
fun formatTimestamp(ts: Any) = if (ts == null) "" else (ts as DateTime as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}) default (ts as String)
fun formatAmount(amt: Any) = if (amt == null) "0.00" else (amt as Number as String {format: "0.00"})
var records = (vars.extractedRecords default []) orderBy (item) -> ((item.flagged_at default item.flaggedAt default "") ++ "_" ++ (item.transaction_id default item.transactionId default "")) --- if (isEmpty(records)) "" else (records map ((item, index) -> [ "D", (index + 1) as String, sanitize(item.transaction_id default item.transactionId), formatTimestamp(item.transaction_timestamp default item.transactionTimestamp), sanitize(item.account_number default item.accountNumber), sanitize(item.customer_id default item.customerId), sanitize(item.customer_name default item.customerName), sanitize(item.customer_type default item.customerType), sanitize(item.transaction_type default item.transactionType), sanitize(item.channel), sanitize(item.currency default vars.runContext.currency default "USD"), formatAmount(item.amount), sanitize(item.counterparty_name default item.counterpartyName), sanitize(item.counterparty_country default item.counterpartyCountry), sanitize(item.flag_code default item.flagCode), sanitize(item.flag_reason default item.flagReason), formatTimestamp(item.flagged_at default item.flaggedAt), sanitize(item.reviewer default item.reviewedBy), sanitize(item.review_status default item.reviewStatus) ] joinBy "|" )) joinBy "\n"

%dw 2.0 output application/json var history = vars.historicalRuns default [] var validHistory = history filter (item) -> (item.run_status == "SUCCESS" or item.runStatus == "SUCCESS") var historyCount = sizeOf(validHistory)
var avgRecordCount = if (historyCount > 0) (sum(validHistory map ((item) -> (item.record_count default item.recordCount default 0) as Number)) / historyCount) else 0.0
var avgTotalAmount = if (historyCount > 0) (sum(validHistory map ((item) -> (item.total_amount default item.totalAmount default 0.00) as Number)) / historyCount) else 0.00
var currentRecords = (vars.runMetrics.recordCount default 0) as Number var currentAmount = (vars.runMetrics.totalAmount default 0.00) as Number
var recordDeviationPct = if (avgRecordCount > 0) (((currentRecords - avgRecordCount) / avgRecordCount) * 100) else 0.0
var amountDeviationPct = if (avgTotalAmount > 0) (((currentAmount - avgTotalAmount) / avgTotalAmount) * 100) else 0.0
var thresholdPct = (p('compliance.deviationThresholdPct') default 50.0) as Number var hasDeviationAlert = if (historyCount > 0) (abs(recordDeviationPct) >= thresholdPct or abs(amountDeviationPct) >= thresholdPct) else false --- { historicalRunsEvaluated: historyCount, avgRecordCount: avgRecordCount as String {format: "0.0"}, avgTotalAmount: avgTotalAmount as String {format: "0.00"}, currentRecordCount: currentRecords, currentTotalAmount: currentAmount as String {format: "0.00"}, recordDeviationPct: (if (recordDeviationPct > 0) "+" else "") ++ (recordDeviationPct as String {format: "0.0"}) ++ "%", amountDeviationPct: (if (amountDeviationPct > 0) "+" else "") ++ (amountDeviationPct as String {format: "0.0"}) ++ "%", thresholdPct: thresholdPct as String {format: "0.0"} ++ "%", hasDeviationAlert: hasDeviationAlert, deviationSeverity: if (!hasDeviationAlert) "NORMAL" else if (abs(recordDeviationPct) > 100 or abs(amountDeviationPct) > 100) "HIGH_DEVIATION" else "MODERATE_DEVIATION" }
